title: Courier Shift
description: A free 3D grocery-delivery simulator by PNLEE Studio. Collect the right order, get through gates and an intercom, and deliver the groceries intact. Finish the first delivery to unlock a 90-second rush order with a blocked path.
how_to_play: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and E to interact. Hold Shift for a careful walk. On touchscreens, use the on-screen controls. Check the order number before picking up the bag.
